title: A Study on Type-2 Isomorphic Circulant Graphs: Part 8: $C_{432}(R)$, $C_{6750}(S)$ -- each has 2 types of Type-2 isomorphic circulant graphs
summary: In this study, we obtain the following two families of circulant graphs each has Type-2 isomorphic circulant graphs w.r.t. $m$ such that $m$ has more than one value. (i) Family of circulant graphs $C_{432}(R)$, each has isomorphic circulant graphs of Type-2 w.r.t. $m$ = 2 as well as $m$ = 3; and (ii) Family of circulant graphs $C_{6750}(S)$, each has isomorphic circulant graphs of Type-2 w.r.t. $m$ = 3 as well as $m$ = 5. This study is the $8^{th}$ part of a detailed study on Type-2 isomorphic circulant graphs having ten parts \cite{v2-1}-\cite{v2-10}.
